name: Varlo
summary: Varlo is built around a honed Dover White marble top in a matte finish, giving it a crisp, sculptural surface with quiet confidence. The body is clad in Techno Walnut veneer, bringing a deep, contemporary texture that adds substance without heaviness. Inside, melamine panels keep the layout sharp and orderly. The vintage brass painted base introduces a grounded metallic note, completing the design with a modern, refined edge. Top with honed Dover white marble (matte),the body all cover with Techno Walnut Veneer,inner panels with melamine. the base paint vintage brass. 220x42x50
